Restore full tools/ engine; align with GitHub fangyuan-3149/book-learning-tutor @ e2d099f (v0.1.1).

- Major cleanup: removed 35 legacy files and directories, including tests, examples, config, and GitHub workflows.
- Added new helper scripts: build_publish.py and tools/common/sanitize.py.
- The core teaching engine remains self-contained and functional for processing and course-ifying local books.
- Documentation and skill interface remain focused on local book transformation and interactive lesson delivery.

Book Learning Tutor 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a self-contained teacher engine to turn user-provided local books into interactive, lesson-based courses.
- Supports various local ebook/document formats (PDF, EPUB, DJVU, MOBI, AZW, DOCX, TXT, MD, CBZ).
- Online book acquisition is strictly optional and only happens with explicit user authorization and confirmation.
- Teaching engine includes prep, detailed Feynman explanations, practice gates, spaced review, recitation homework, and self-evolution.
- Skill works independently; no other skill is required to be loaded at runtime.
- Compatible with multiple host agents and platforms via the Agent Skills open standard; MIT licensed.
